# Your weekly wearing digest
**11–17 October 2026 · Autumn**

This week balances autumn warmth with fresh contrasts: **35 different perfumes from your collection**, all rated at least 3/5, without repeating your five recent wears. These are options to browse—not a 35-wear assignment.

*Record note: some zero-wear counts have last-worn dates. I’ve described those counts as recorded, rather than assuming the perfumes are unworn; missing dates aren’t treated as evidence of a long absence.*

## ForgottenFavorite
Highly rated perfumes with dated absences of more than 90 days—strong candidates for a welcome rediscovery.

- **Digest House 1 — Woody Study 36:** Your 4.8/5 cedar favorite hasn’t appeared since 6 February; an excellent autumn reunion.
- **Digest House 7 — Green Study 35:** Rated 4.6/5 and last worn 13 February. Its minty-green profile offers a refreshing alternative to seasonal sweetness.
- **Digest House 5 — Aquatic Study 26:** Twelve recorded wears and a 4.6/5 rating suggest an established favorite; bring its marine freshness back after an April absence.
- **Digest House 4 — Oriental Study 18:** Your 4.8/5 amber-spice option has rested since 12 June—well timed for an October return.
- **Digest House 3 — Citrus Study 17:** Bergamot brightness, a 4.6/5 rating, and no wear since 19 June make this a cheerful rediscovery.

## SimilarToLastUsed
Familiar directions in different bottles, linked to the families of your recent wears. These are family-and-tag connections, not claims that the perfumes smell identical.

- **Digest House 2 — Floral Study 16:** A rose-tagged alternative to your latest wear, Floral Study 02, with a stronger personal rating of 4.4/5.
- **Digest House 3 — Citrus Study 24:** Keeps the bergamot-and-citrus thread of Citrus Study 03 while revisiting a bottle last worn in May.
- **Digest House 4 — Oriental Study 25:** Continues Oriental Study 04’s amber-spice direction; your 4.4/5 rating makes it an appealing variation.
- **Digest House 5 — Aquatic Study 33:** Shares Aquatic Study 05’s fresh marine tags, but gives a February-rested bottle another turn.
- **Digest House 6 — Gourmand Study 13:** Follows Gourmand Study 06’s cozy vanilla theme; twelve recorded wears give you an established alternative.

## Seasonal
Cedar, amber, and vanilla anchor the autumn selection, with rose and mint keeping it from becoming uniformly warm and sweet.

- **Digest House 1 — Woody Study 22:** Its cedar-and-wood profile is my pick for an autumn walk; you’ve previously described it as cheerful for daytime.
- **Digest House 4 — Oriental Study 32:** Amber and spice offer a classic autumn direction, with no recorded outing since March.
- **Digest House 6 — Gourmand Study 34:** Your 4.4/5 vanilla option supplies the cozy counterpoint. Its missing last-worn date leaves the timing uncertain, not its seasonal appeal.
- **Digest House 2 — Floral Study 23:** Rose provides a floral break between the woods and gourmands; your quiet-afternoon comment supports an unhurried outing.
- **Digest House 7 — Green Study 28:** Minty greenery is the deliberate contrast here—try it on a brighter autumn afternoon rather than defaulting to amber.

## Random — Adventurous surprises
Adventure this week means changing the setting: marine freshness in October, citrus after dark, and warm spice in daylight.

- **Digest House 5 — Aquatic Study 12:** Try its marine profile on an autumn evening instead of choosing something warm; eleven recorded wears suggest familiar territory in a different setting.
- **Digest House 3 — Citrus Study 10:** Take this bergamot-citrus bottle into an evening slot—a playful change from its cheerful daytime association.
- **Digest House 7 — Green Study 21:** Make minty green the centerpiece of a cool-weather day, deliberately stepping away from cozy vanilla.
- **Digest House 4 — Oriental Study 11:** Move amber and spice into a quiet daytime outing; your own afternoon comment makes that experiment grounded rather than arbitrary.
- **Digest House 2 — Floral Study 30:** Give rose an autumn-weekend role. With three recorded wears and a March last-worn date, it deserves a fresh appraisal.

## LeastUsed
Four bottles with zero recorded wears, plus one with a single wear: a focused chance to get to know the quieter corners of your collection.

- **Digest House 1 — Woody Study 01:** Zero recorded wears and no last-worn date make this cedar bottle the clearest candidate for an introductory outing.
- **Digest House 5 — Aquatic Study 40:** The counter is zero despite a January date; use a fresh marine wearing to establish a clearer current impression.
- **Digest House 6 — Gourmand Study 27:** A striking 4.8/5 rating beside zero recorded wears makes this cozy vanilla especially worth exploring.
- **Digest House 7 — Green Study 14:** Rated 4/5 with zero recorded wears; give its green-mint profile a deliberate, logged day.
- **Digest House 1 — Woody Study 15:** Just one recorded wear, despite a 4.2/5 rating. Cedar and your quiet-afternoon comment make a relaxed revisit appealing.

## LongestTimeAgo
Five of your oldest **dated** absences, chosen across different houses and families. Undated records are excluded because their elapsed time is unknown.

- **Digest House 7 — Green Study 42:** Last worn **26 December 2025**—the oldest dated wear supplied. Its 4.2/5 minty-green profile leads the return queue.
- **Digest House 6 — Gourmand Study 41:** Last worn **2 January 2026**. Cozy vanilla and your quiet-afternoon note make this an inviting October return.
- **Digest House 4 — Oriental Study 39:** Last worn **16 January 2026**; twelve recorded wears give this amber-spice bottle a substantial history to reconnect with.
- **Digest House 3 — Citrus Study 38:** Last worn **23 January 2026**. Revisit its bergamot brightness before warmer scents take over your rotation.
- **Digest House 2 — Floral Study 37:** Last worn **30 January 2026**. Ten recorded wears make this rose bottle worth reassessing after its long break.

## MoodOrOccasion — A slow bookshop-and-café afternoon
For this October week, the mood is unhurried browsing followed by a warm drink: comforting options, with brighter choices if you want a lift.

- **Digest House 1 — Woody Study 08:** Cedar suits the bookshop mood, while your cheerful daytime comment keeps the choice grounded in your experience.
- **Digest House 6 — Gourmand Study 20:** Cozy vanilla is the café-side pick; your daytime note supports making it an afternoon pleasure.
- **Digest House 2 — Floral Study 09:** Your 4.8/5 rose option comes with a quiet-afternoon endorsement—a particularly personal fit for this occasion.
- **Digest House 3 — Citrus Study 31:** Bergamot offers a brighter interpretation of the same relaxed outing, supported by your quiet-afternoon comment.
- **Digest House 7 — Green Study 07:** Minty greenery supplies a fresh alternative to sweetness, again with an afternoon association in your notes.
